title: Detect complete deletion of authenticated DAO TX state
description: python/src/lichen/rpl/dao_persistence.py uses .dao_tx_initialized to detect slot deletion, but the marker lives beside the slots and is itself unauthenticated/unanchored. Deleting both dao_tx slots and the marker makes load_tx_state return None as if first boot; DaoManager with allow_tx_bootstrap=True can then reuse Origin Sequence 1 for the same key, contrary spec/05-routing.md lines 249-257. Store the initialized/high-water fact in an independent monotonic anchor or provisioned per-key floor that cannot disappear with the slots, and add a restart test deleting marker plus both slots.
close_reason: Verified implemented: code and bead-mandated adversarial tests present and passing (test_key_persistence.py, test_dao_persistence.py, test_trust.py: 200/200).
